Metadata.title: SmartAutoBid — Bid, Buy & Ship Cars from Copart & IAAI to Europe, the Middle East & Beyond
Metadata.description: SmartAutoBid bids and buys vehicles for you at Copart and IAAI auctions in the USA, then handles documentation and ocean freight all the way to your door — in Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.

Footer.tagline: From the auction lane to your driveway — we bid, buy, and ship U.S. vehicles to Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.
Footer.disclaimer: SmartAutoBid is an independent buying and logistics agent. We purchase on our clients' behalf at Copart and IAAI public auctions and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting as an official representative of Copart or IAAI.

hero.title: We built the bridge we wished existed
hero.subtitle: SmartAutoBid exists because buying a U.S. vehicle from overseas shouldn't require a broker's license, a customs law degree, and a friend in Savannah.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: SmartAutoBid started with a simple frustration: incredible vehicles sell every day at Copart and IAAI auctions across the U.S., but buyers overseas are locked out — no dealer license, no local presence, no way to inspect a lot in person.

We built a team that lives inside that gap. Buyers who know how to read an auction report, a logistics desk that knows every export document by heart, and a support team that speaks the languages our clients do.
Today we source, buy, and ship vehicles from coast to coast in the U.S. to ports across Europe, the Caucasus, and the Middle East — handling the parts our clients never want to think about twice.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we hear most before someone sends their first inquiry.

items.question: How does bidding work?
items.answer: Tell us the lot number, or the make, model, and budget you're after. We review the listing, agree a maximum bid with you in writing, and bid on your behalf directly at Copart or IAAI under our own account. We never bid past the limit you approve.

items.question: What happens if we don't win the bid?
items.answer: There's no cost to you — we only charge fees once a vehicle is actually purchased. You're welcome to set a new limit or try another lot.

items.question: What condition are the vehicles in?
items.answer: Most vehicles sourced through Copart and IAAI are salvage, insurance, or wholesale vehicles sold as-is. We review the auction's condition report and photos in good faith before bidding, but we don't inspect vehicles in person unless specifically arranged with you.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: We provide our brokerage fee plus an estimate of auction, transport, and shipping costs in writing before we place any bid, so you know the full picture upfront — no surprise line items.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Timelines vary by carrier schedule, port congestion, and customs processing, so we give you an estimate rather than a fixed date, and keep you updated at each shipping milestone.

items.question: Where do you ship to?
items.answer: We regularly ship to Klaipėda (Lithuania), Poti (Georgia), and Rotterdam (Netherlands), with additional ports across Europe, the Caucasus, and the Middle East available on request.

items.question: Who handles customs and import duties?
items.answer: We prepare the export documentation on the U.S. side. Import duties, VAT, and destination-country compliance are the client's responsibility, though we're happy to help coordinate with your local customs broker.

items.question: What languages do you support?
items.answer: Our team works with clients in English, Russian, and Lithuanian.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information when you use SmartAutoBid.

sections.title: Who we are
body: This Privacy Policy explains how Smart Auto Bid LLC ("SmartAutoBid," "we," "us"), a Georgia, USA limited liability company registered at 289 Telfair Rd #I, Savannah, GA 31415, USA, collects, uses, and protects information when you visit smartautobid.com or contact us through it.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: Contact and quote requests: when you submit our contact form, we collect your name, email address, phone number (if provided), the vehicle or budget details you describe, and any message you write.
Cost calculator: if you request a price estimate for a route we don't have instant pricing for, we collect the email address you provide so we can follow up with a quote.

Technical data: like most websites, our hosting infrastructure may automatically log standard technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and pages visited, for security and performance purposes.
Language preference: we store a small cookie recording which language (English, Russian, or Lithuanian) you've selected, so the site remembers it on your next visit.

sections.title: How we use your information
body: To respond to your inquiry and provide a quote for bidding, purchase, and shipping services.
To provide the services you request if you become a client, including bid management, documentation, and shipment coordination.
To communicate with you about your inquiry or order, in your selected language where possible.
To maintain and improve the security and functionality of our website.
We do not use your information for automated advertising profiling, and we do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Cookies
body: SmartAutoBid uses strictly necessary, functional cookies that don't require consent — for example, a cookie that remembers your selected site language.

With your consent, we also use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site so we can improve it. These analytics cookies are only set after you accept them in the cookie banner shown on your first visit — you're free to decline, and your choice doesn't affect your ability to use the site.
We do not use advertising or marketing cookies, and we do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: How we share your information
body: Email delivery: messages submitted through our contact form are delivered to our team via a standard email service provider, which processes the message only to deliver it to us.

Auction platforms: if you ask us to bid on a specific lot, we act on your behalf directly with Copart or IAAI using our own account — we do not share your personal contact details with them unless it's necessary to complete a purchase or shipment you've authorized.

Shipping and customs partners: once you're a client, we share the information necessary to arrange inland transport, export documentation, ocean freight, and customs clearance with vetted logistics and customs partners.
Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to valid legal process.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Data retention
body: We keep inquiry and client information for as long as needed to respond to you, provide our services, meet our legal, tax, and accounting obligations, and resolve any disputes — after which we delete or anonymize it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: If you are located in the European Economic Area, you have the right under GDPR to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, to object to certain processing, to receive a copy of your data in a portable format, and to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Regardless of where you're located, you can contact us at any time using the details below to ask what information we hold about you or to request that we delete it, and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: International data transfers
body: SmartAutoBid is based in the United States, and information you submit is processed and stored there. By using our site or services, clients located outside the U.S. — including in the EU/EEA — acknowledge that their information will be transferred to and processed in the United States.

sections.title: Data security
body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect the information you share with us. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Children's privacy
body: Our services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

sections.title: Contact us
body: Questions about this policy or your information can be sent to info@smartautobid.com, by phone or WhatsApp at +1 (912) 561-2347, or by mail to Smart Auto Bid LLC, 289 Telfair Rd #I, Savannah, GA 31415, USA.

sections.title: Acceptance of these terms
body: By using smartautobid.com or engaging Smart Auto Bid LLC ("SmartAutoBid," "we," "us") to bid on, purchase, or ship a vehicle, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please don't use our services.

sections.title: Who we are
body: SmartAutoBid is a vehicle buying and logistics agent operated by Smart Auto Bid LLC, a Georgia, USA limited liability company. We search for, bid on, and purchase vehicles on our clients' behalf at Copart and IAAI public salvage and used-vehicle auctions, and arrange inland transport, export documentation, ocean freight, and delivery to ports in Europe, the Caucasus, and the Middle East. We are not Copart, IAAI, or an auction house, and we are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official representative of either company.

sections.title: Eligibility
body: You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal authority to enter into a binding agreement to use our services.

sections.title: Bidding is not guaranteed to win
body: Auctions are run entirely by Copart and IAAI under their own rules. We bid on your behalf up to the maximum amount you approve in writing, but we cannot guarantee that any bid will win, and the final sale price and outcome are determined solely by the auction platform.

sections.title: Vehicle condition
body: Most vehicles available through Copart and IAAI are salvage, insurance, or wholesale vehicles sold as-is, with no warranty. Condition reports and photos are produced by the auction platform, not by us; while we review available listing information in good faith before bidding, we do not independently inspect vehicles in person unless you've specifically arranged that with us, and we are not responsible for discrepancies between a listing and the vehicle's actual condition.

sections.title: Fees, deposits & payment
body: Before we place any bid on your behalf, we provide you in writing with our brokerage fee and an estimate of auction, transport, and shipping costs, and no bid is placed without your prior approval of a maximum bid amount. Deposit requirements and payment terms vary by vehicle and route and are set out in your individual quote or purchase agreement.

sections.title: Shipping & delivery timelines
body: Shipping timelines we provide are estimates only. Actual transit times depend on ocean carrier schedules, port congestion, and customs processing at origin and destination, and are outside our direct control.

sections.title: Customs, duties & compliance
body: You are responsible for complying with the import laws of your destination country. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, import duties, VAT, excise taxes, and any destination-country compliance requirements are your responsibility.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
body: Our services are provided on an as-available basis. To the maximum extent permitted by law, SmartAutoBid is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, for errors, misrepresentations, or unavailability of third-party auction platforms, or for delays caused by carriers, customs authorities, or other circumstances outside our reasonable control. Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the fees you paid SmartAutoBid for the transaction giving rise to the claim.

sections.title: Third-party auction platforms
body: Our search tool links directly to Copart's and IAAI's own websites, which have their own terms of use and privacy practices. We are not responsible for the content, availability, or accuracy of those third-party platforms.

Any dispute not resolved informally will be handled in the courts located in Chatham County, Georgia, except where applicable consumer protection law in your home country requires otherwise.
